payload.leagueSummary: NET is being won at the top by guys who can actually finish holes instead of just talking a big game on the tee box. Dan94 and MattF are the cleanest net scorers in the window, while KeithK75 is the gross monster who keeps turning rounds into a putting-and-approach mugging. Below that, the field gets messy fast: BigTime and IUDoc92 are donating too many strokes around the greens and on the greens, and the bottom half is mostly a parade of missed fairways, thin contact, and scorecards that look personally offended.
leagueBullets: Dan94 is the full-package leader right now: bomb it, stripe it, and then let the putter do the dirty work. The zero 3-putts in the window is not a coincidence, it’s a threat.

KeithK75 is the gross bully because the ball-striking keeps showing up even when the net math doesn’t hand him everything. This is the rare profile where the irons are carrying the whole damn operation.

BigTime and DREADFUL are the cautionary tales: one has a massive short-game/putting leak, the other showed up once and spent the round paying interest on every missed green. That’s not volatility, that’s the sim golfing equivalent of setting money on fire.
